dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: I heard the sound of footsteps from afar, and here you are.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>How do you like it here?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hm, I believe that the utopia referenced in literature would likely resemble this place.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Peaceful and comforting, enough for one to forget the time while pouring oneself into research.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yes, of course.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Ah, right...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: I will often sketch my surroundings. Your arrangements in this realm also provide a source of inspiration for me.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: ...Thank you.

choices.text: You can tell me if you need anything.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hm... Let your creative instincts run unabated, and I should be quite content.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Would you like to have a chat with me?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Certainly.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Uh... I will let you decide the topic of our conversation.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Yes, this is a habit that I formed a long time ago.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Initially, it was for research purposes. I originally tried to reproduce subjects with a rubbing technique.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: However, the results were inadequate and lacked spirit.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: After that, I tried to learn how to draw.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: While refining my artistic skills, I unconsciously found myself engrossed in drawing.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm, anything else...?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Probably you.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: At first, it was because you carry the aura of the stars.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But now... it seems that there is more to it.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Why is this? Give me some time and I can conduct experiments to find out.

choices.text: You really like to conduct experiments...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Hmm, if you ask me, the world is a limitless library.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: There's a multitude of research topics for experiments...

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You can use your own hands to unearth unknown secrets and ultimately master new knowledge.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This sort of feeling is captivating.

choices.text: Is there anything else you're interested in?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Heh, where should I begin...?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: In your company, I never lack inspiration.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: It's good for both drawing and experiments.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: And not just for these, but for many other things.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Speaking of which... I used to think interaction with others was a waste of time.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: But after meeting you, I'd rather spend my time on you than other matters.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: This is a unique anomaly. I think I likely know the reason why.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: So can you also... give me more of your time?

choices.text: I'll accompany you while you sketch.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Thank you. Then, today's subject—

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: You and your realm.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: By the way, after we're done, may I have the pleasure of inviting you to dessert with me?

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: To continue our time together, and to thank you for your company.

choices.text: I'll accompany you during your experiments.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: Thank you. I'll guarantee your safety, as I've done before.

response.speaker: Albedo
response.text: We already understand each other quite well, don't we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: #Morning, {NICKNAME}. I've already organized my next stage of research objectives.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: But should you have other arrangements, I don't necessarily mind revising my plans.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Albedo.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Good night. May you have sweet dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: ...You don't require me to read you a bedtime story, do you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: This is a nice workshop. Looks like I will be able to continue my research here as well.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Hmm, I believe that you must have acquired some sort of secret art that allows you to copy things from the real world, is this not so?

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, I'd like to conduct some further research with you. Perhaps it may be of some help to you.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: A fascinating copy... You have attended to every fine detail — even the feeling of the wilderness that one can only experience when adventuring themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Alright then. I'll go ahead and start sketching.

dialogues.speaker: Albedo
dialogues.text: Would you mind... if I make you the subject matter of my sketch?
